Coverage is city as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. The provider lists application/zipped-shapefile formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence terms are linked in the provider metadata and require reading before reuse. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: This is a local model domain and requires the Q1 and Q2 scope decisions. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence.
